outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of Tmprss11b normalized counts across mouse models, with individual biological replicate data points overlaid as colored dots (red for SCLC, blue for LUSC, orange for LUAD).
Panel B is a schematic diagram illustrating the experimental workflow (Ad-Cre administration, MRI imaging, sacrifice/H&E), not a data plot.
Panel C shows representative MRI images (photograph/imaging data), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D shows representative H&E micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel E shows H&E and RNAscope micrograph images with annotated regions, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel F shows representative H&E and RNAscope micrograph images comparing squamous tumors and normal lung, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G shows H&E and RNAscope micrograph images with annotated regions, not a plot of averaged data.
